notes: Positive: explicit threat-modelling requests, STRIDE/PASTA invocations, 'where can this be attacked', Spanish triggers. Negative: implement mitigation, security incident RCA, code review for security issues without modelling, full architecture, compliance certification. Edge: re-review request; threat model for a feature still in design (no code yet to ground in).
